name: Ear
description: '''Ear''' (stylized in [[lowercase]]) is an American [[electronic music]] duo consisting of musicians and producers Jonah Paz and Yaelle Avtan, formed in 2024. The group released their debut album ''The Most Dear and the Future'' in September 2025, with the song "Real Life" was listed among the best songs of 2025 by ''[[The Fader]]''.
